Exterior detailing

Clean paint, done carefully.

Most swirl marks are put into paint during washing, so the wash itself matters. Exterior Refresh starts with a foam pre-wash to loosen grit before the hand wash, then the wheels, tyres and arches, a hand dry and tyre dressing.

Washing does not remove everything. Bonded contamination such as iron fallout, tar and road film stays on the paint and makes it feel rough. Deep Exterior adds iron and tar removal, a clay bar decontamination and a spray sealant; Protected Finish uses a machine-applied sealant that lasts roughly 6–12 months, plus trim and glass protection.

Wrapped vehicles need a different approach: matte and satin films should not be polished or waxed, so tell us the film brand and finish and we adapt the products. For deeper swirls see paint correction; for longer-term protection see ceramic coating or paint protection film.

FAQ

Before you get started.

Can you detail a wrapped vehicle?
Tell us the film brand and finish. Matte and satin films need different care from glossy paint.
How is the price confirmed?
The plans show typical GTA starting prices for a sedan, before tax. SUVs, trucks and heavily soiled vehicles cost more — we confirm the exact price after a quick look and before any work begins.
Can I book online?
Yes. Choose your services and a preferred date and time on the booking page. The time is a request: our team contacts you to confirm the scope, the price and the appointment.
